name: Alappuzha
summary: Venice of the East, world-famous for palm-lined backwaters, houseboats, and the Nehru Trophy Boat Race.
points: Vembanad Lake hosts the annual Punnamada snake boat races (Vallam Kali)
Center of India's coir processing and backwater tourism economy

name: Ernakulam
summary: Commercial and financial capital of Kerala centered at Kochi, historic spice port with Chinese fishing nets.
points: Fort Kochi was the first European colonial settlement in India (Portuguese 1500 CE)
Home to Cochin Shipyard, Southern Naval Command, and Kochi Metro

name: Idukki
summary: Mountainous Western Ghats highland boasting Munnar tea estates, Eravikulam National Park, and Idukki Arch Dam.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Idukki Green Cardamom, Tea packaging

points: Anamudi peak (2,695 m) is the highest summit in South India
Idukki Dam is one of the highest double-curvature concrete arch dams in Asia

name: Kannur
summary: Land of Looms and Lores on the North Malabar coast, world-famous for ritualistic Theyyam performances and handloom.
points: St. Angelo Fort built in 1505 CE by the first Portuguese Viceroy Dom Francisco de Almeida
Seat of the Arakkal kingdom, the only Muslim royal dynasty in Kerala history

name: Kasaragod
summary: Northernmost coastal district, Land of Gods and Seven Languages, famed for coastal Bekal Fort and Ananthapura Lake Temple.

profile.Crafts: Bell metal ware, Kasaragod handloom cotton sarees

points: Bekal Fort built in 1650 CE by Shivappa Nayaka of Keladi, Kerala's largest historic fort
Only lake temple in Kerala situated at Ananthapura

name: Kollam
summary: Cashew Capital of the World on the shores of Ashtamudi Lake, ancient seaport of Quilon described by Marco Polo.
points: Historic port of Quilon traded with Phoenicians, Romans, Arabs, and Ming dynasty China
Gateway to the backwaters via the scenic 8-hour Kollam-Alappuzha water ferry

name: Kottayam
summary: City of Letters, Lakes, and Latex; India's first 100% literate municipal town, heart of natural rubber estates.
points: First town in India to achieve 100% literacy in 1989
Kumarakom bird sanctuary on the edge of Vembanad Lake hosts migratory Siberian storks

name: Kozhikode
summary: City of Spices and Calico, historic capital of the Samoothiri (Zamorin) where Vasco da Gama landed in 1498 CE.

profile.Food: Kozhikodan Halwa, Malabar Dum Biryani, Banana Chips
profile.Crafts: Beypore wooden dhow boat building (Uru), Calico cotton

points: Vasco da Gama landed at Kappad beach near Kozhikode on 20 May 1498 discovering the sea route to India
Declared India's first UNESCO City of Literature in 2023

name: Malappuram
summary: Hill city between Western Ghats and Arabian Sea, center of Islamic scholarship, Ayurvedic research, and football passion.

profile.Crafts: Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala Ayurvedic medicines

points: Kottakkal is world-renowned center of classical Ayurvedic healing founded in 1902 by Vaidyaratnam P. S. Varier
Thirunavaya on Bharathappuzha was the traditional venue for the 12-yearly Mamankam festival

name: Palakkad
summary: Granary of Kerala, marked by the 30-km natural mountain pass Palakkad Gap connecting Kerala to Tamil Nadu plains.
points: Palakkad Fort built in 1766 CE by Hyder Ali of Mysore with massive granite ramparts
Silent Valley National Park protects one of the last undisturbed rain forests in India

name: Pathanamthitta
summary: Pilgrimage capital of Kerala, home to hill shrine Sabarimala in Periyar Tiger Reserve, and Aranmula metal mirrors.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Aranmula Kannadi (front-surface metal alloy mirrors)

points: Sabarimala Ayyappa Temple atop the forested hills attracts over 30 million pilgrims annually
Aranmula metal mirror is an exclusive metallurgical secret preserved by a few master artisan families

name: Thiruvananthapuram
summary: Capital of Kerala, Ever-Green City of India, home to Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Kovalam beach, and ISRO VSSC.

profile.Food: Boli with Palpayasam, Kappa with Meen curry

points: Padmanabhaswamy Temple houses estimated $20+ billion in consecrated gold and gemstone treasures
Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station established here in 1963 launched India's space program

name: Thrissur
summary: Cultural Capital of Kerala, famed for the grand Thrissur Pooram festival, Vadakkunnathan Temple, and gold jewelry.

profile.Crafts: Gold jewelry manufacturing, Bell metal lamps

points: Host to the annual Thrissur Pooram festival featuring 30 caparisoned elephants and Kudamattam umbrella exchanges
Vadakkunnathan Temple won UNESCO Asia-Pacific Award of Excellence for heritage conservation

name: Wayanad
summary: Misty high plateau of the Western Ghats known for Edakkal prehistoric cave petroglyphs, tea estates, and spices.

profile.Food: Bamboo rice payasam, Wayanad pepper chicken

points: Edakkal Caves feature Neolithic human rock engravings dating back to 6000 BCE
Banasura Sagar Dam is the largest earthen dam in India and second largest in Asia
